description: This file contains the implementation of the Product controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce system. It handles displaying individual product details, setting page metadata, managing breadcrumbs, and loading related models such as product, category, manufacturer, and stock status. It primarily serves to generate the product detail page interface.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: This class extends the base Controller class to handle product detail page logic, including data gathering, page metadata setup, and rendering for a specific product identified by 'product_id'.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads product data based on 'product_id' from the request, sets metadata, breadcrumbs, loads additional models for manufacturer, category, and stock status, and prepares data for rendering the product page view.
